title: Moderna首席执行官：癌症疫苗疗效有望超越黑色素瘤
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Fresh offer presentation over at Asimom Madrid on a treatment that I think a lot of folks have been looking forward to both in terms of patients as well as investors.
segments.zh: 在Asimom Madrid，有一项关于治疗方法的全新展示，我认为许多患者和市场参与者都对此充满期待。

segments.en: There's been a lot of questions now, not only about the efficacy of this as a drug, but the efficacy as a commercial business model.
segments.zh: 现在有很多问题，不仅关乎这种药物作为药物的疗效，还关乎其作为商业模式的效力。

segments.en: Georgina, along the doctor who presented on this, she called this a penicillin moment.
segments.zh: 乔治娜，与介绍这项研究的医生一起，她称这是一个青霉素时刻。

segments.en: You've talked this up. David Burman has also said this could actually be transformational, is it?
segments.zh: 你对此大加宣传。大卫·伯曼也表示这实际上可能具有变革性，是吗？

segments.en: Yeah, thank you for having me. We figured it's a landmark study.
segments.zh: 是的，感谢邀请。我们认为这是一项里程碑式的研究。

segments.en: If you think about the performance at two years in the study and we're going to get more data as time goes by, it was a 42% improvement versus Ketudra.
segments.zh: 如果考虑研究中两年的表现，随着时间推移我们会获得更多数据，与Ketudra相比，改善了42%。

segments.en: So let's put that into context. Ketudra was available in 2018, and if you look at the data compared to placebo, it was a 43% improvement.
segments.zh: 让我们将其置于背景中。Ketudra于2018年上市，如果看与安慰剂相比的数据，改善了43%。

segments.en: This is 42% improvement versus Ketudra. So the bar was really high. And for context, there were three large studies done before us trying to improve on Ketudra and they all failed.
segments.zh: 这是与Ketudra相比改善了42%。所以门槛真的很高。作为背景，在我们之前有三项大型研究试图改进Ketudra，但都失败了。

segments.en: So we think about this for for clinician, for patient. It's a landmark study where very happy of the data.
segments.zh: 所以我们对临床医生和患者来说，这是一项里程碑式的研究，我们对数据非常满意。

segments.en: And if you look at our face to data, actually our data improved over time. So we anticipate, I personally believe that the data is going to improve with time.
segments.zh: 如果看我们的数据，实际上我们的数据随时间改善。所以我预计，我个人相信数据会随着时间变得更好。

segments.en: So you're referring to Ketudra, Mark's drug obviously, but there has been some concerns about what the cost of your treatment would be and whether that would actually justify adding that to Ketudra.
segments.zh: 所以你指的是Ketudra，显然是Mark的药物，但有人担心你们的治疗成本，以及这是否真的值得将其加入Ketudra。
